blurb: Guests take boat cruises around Sackets Harbor and nearby islands with options for group, private, fishing, and custom concierge cruises. Cruises include sightseeing, swimming, historical tours, and fishing for local species. Private cruises allow flexible itineraries including sunset and anniversary cruises.
